experimental_method: Compressed N2 saturated with water in a thermostatted high-pressure apparatus (dead-weight piston gage); liquid samples expanded to measure dissolved N2 volume, gas-phase water content by condensation in liquid-air traps and weighing, gas density from expansion of a closed pipet.
uncertainties_stated: Average deviation of replicate experiments tabulated per row (liquid mostly ~0.75%, 1-2% at high T; gas phase about 0.4-3.5%); weighing error under 0.3 mg per tube.
quality_remarks: Table III heading prints 'Press., cm.' (evident misprint for atm.). Authors note gas-phase density at 230 C shows larger variation. Temperature scale not stated.
not_extracted_tables: Table III (gas phase density and compressibility factors): gas-phase density, not an in-scope property
Table IV (Henry's law constants): derived by authors

extraction_notes: Sanity: Table II H2O + N2 columns sum to 1 in every row; water content increases with T at fixed P. Table I X is non-monotonic in T at fixed P (minimum near 70-80 C), as in Fig. 2.
